cases.name: David Vance Gardner v. Runway AI, Inc.
Businessing LLC v. Runway AI, Inc.
David Vance Gardner v. Runway AI, Inc.
Ace Cam, Inc. v. Runway AI Inc

profile_text.body:
Runway is a New York-based AI startup, founded in 2018, that describes itself as building foundational "Real-World Intelligence" capable of understanding, simulating, and acting in the world. The company says its products and services are built on top of this intelligence layer, with every component powered by GWM-1, which it describes as a state-of-the-art General World Model built to interact with the real world and intended as a step toward universal simulation. Applications the company highlights include policy inference and evaluation and synthetic data generation. Runway has announced a London European headquarters and world model research hub, alongside a planned $100 million investment in the UK AI ecosystem.

The company's primary tracked product is its video generation platform, also called Runway, which falls under the video generation and editing category. The company has published work under the name Project Luxo, describing early evidence that AI-generated video is beginning to cross the uncanny valley.

On the litigation side, Runway AI, Inc. is named as a defendant in several federal cases, including actions brought by David Vance Gardner in both the Southern District of New York and the Central District of California, as well as suits filed by Businessing LLC and Ace Cam, Inc. in the Southern District of New York. Runway is also listed as a party in Andersen v. Stability AI Ltd., filed in the Northern District of California, a case that also involves other AI companies.
